# load the data
cases, deaths = germany_get_region(landkreis="LK Kusel")

# get population of the region for future normalisation:
inhabitants = population(country="Germany", subregion="LK Kusel")
print(f'Population of country="Germany", subregion="LK Kusel": {inhabitants} people')

# compose into one table
table = compose_dataframe_summary(cases, deaths)

# show tables with up to 500 rows
pd.set_option("max_rows", 500)

# display the table
table
